correctness.rationale: For fixed nonzero reduced rational α=±a/b, the exact circle-distance inequality partitions each m<n into unique log-ratio branches j/a at sufficiently small bs/(aN). The j=0 branch has n-m=bh and normalized counts (1-ah/s)_+. For j>0, c=e^(j/a) is irrational by Hermite–Lindemann; Weyl equidistribution of the translated residue-b lattice gives unordered contribution s/(ac). The geometric sum over c=e^(j/a) converges, and the uniform O(sum_{j>J}e^(-j/a)+log N/N) estimate justifies interchange of branch sum and limit. Diagonal s=0 is excluded by transcendence. Thus F_a(s)=2s/[a(e^(1/a)-1)]+2 Σ_{h≥1}(1-ah/s)_+ (s>0), independent of b/sign, with exact threshold cusps. Independently checked finite direct pair counts at N=40000, s=1.5 for α=1,1/2,1/3,2,-1/2; these are corroboration, not convergence proof.
